text: player
Ichihime
Sniff, sniff... Master, I smell roast goose, shrimp dumplings, barbecued pork, and roast squab, nyaa!
We're here to check on Bamboo Cloud's security, not to eat. Besides, didn't you eat a bunch of snacks before you left?
Miki said that I'm a growing girl. An extra snack or two won't do any harm, nyaa.
Ichihime and I chat on our way to Bamboo Cloud's kitchen. I have to admit, having someone to keep your company at work makes the time much more fun and relaxing.
Stop right there!
With a sharp cry, a white blur comes hurtling straight at us.
Again?!
Having developed a knack for dodging assassination attempts during my time at Bamboo Cloud, I promptly grab Ichihime and sidestep out of the way.
Phew, that was a close one! Looks like it's time I talked to the boss about getting health insurance and accident coverage...
Nyaa? A pigeon?
As the white shape approaches, I realize that it is in fact a pigeon – a rather chubby one, flapping its wings with all its might and fluttering about in a bit of a panic.
You're not getting away from me!
A gleam of silver flashes before my eyes. A ball of "flame" with a silver trail flies right past my eyelid, closing in on the pigeon and sealing its fate.
Ichihime... did you see that? That thing was so close it almost grazed my eyelid!
Nyaa... Master, that pigeon's about to become a roast squab.
I suddenly think of last night's bedtime reading: "How Do You Rank in a Cat's Eyes?"
Who are you? And what are you doing here?
I turn to face the voice and see a girl wearing a black eye mask standing a short distance away. Her ponytail sways in the wind as she grips a silver spear with a red tassel dangling from it.
It would seem that the pigeon's fate was the handiwork of this spear.
Hello, I'm here to coordinate with the security personnel.
Blindfolded Girl
Ah, so it's you... Hm... You're early, but since you're already here, let's begin.
Begin... what?
The wind will reveal your position!
W-Wait a minute –
Before I can react, the girl's spear shoots toward me like a fierce dragon!
Nyaa!! Quick, Master, hide!!
Hide behind the well!
Hide behind the stone table!
Hide behind the spear rack!
I quickly step behind the well and attempt to conceal myself.
Hm... You were quiet, but I still heard you. You ran 11, maybe 12, steps away.
(whispers) No one's hearing is that good, right?
That stone table should be solid enough to block any attack! I make a run for the other side of it and crouch down into a ball.
Huh? You think you can hide there?
(whispers) How did she find me? That eye mask isn't see-through, is it...?
I look at the nearby weapons rack and get an idea.
Nyaa! Master, you can't beat her! Nyaa? Oh... never mind.
As Ichihime cries out in a panic, I stealthily slip behind the weapons rack.
(whispers) I may not be able to beat her, but I can hide from her, can't I?
First, second, third – Judging from the direction your voice is coming from... You wouldn't be hiding behind the fourth spear, would you?
Huh???
Caught you!

As her last word falls, the girl abruptly leaps to her feet. With a flurry of movement, the tip of her spear stops precisely at the corner of my clothing. It lightly touches the surface, lingering for the briefest moment before retracting, quick as a flicker.
Just enough to make my point.
Whoa, cool, nyaa! You got totally owned, Master!
What a disastrous start to the security inspection! Even my ally betrayed me! But hey, I'm down but not out.
Ahem, there's no denying your skill. However, I'm afraid that brandishing weapons goes against Bamboo Cloud's security regulations.
I knew you'd bounce back from that in no time, Master! Nyaa!
Security? Isn't that my department?
Your department? Hang on –
Yuzu
Argh! Looks like it wasn't an unlawful brawl, but a lawful duel.
A duel requires the consent of both parties!
Kaavi
Fate usually never allows archnemeses to become...
Kaavi? You're here too... Wait a minute, where did all these people come from?!
As soon as I turn around, I realize a crowd has already gathered behind me, with even more people heading over. And to get a better view, some are perched atop... the wall?
The denizens of One Han City just can't resist a bit of excitement.
Ransei
I had no idea that you were so skilled at both mahjong and combat! I really need to take some tips from you!
Eve Krist
Is that a traditional weapon of Nanxiang? It sure lives up to its reputation.
...Is the martial arts tournament being held in Bamboo Cloud's courtyard this year?
Hibiki Himekawa
Let's pick up from where we left off last time!
A few days ago, a blindfolded heroine valiantly raised her spear, and all the villains who descended upon Bamboo Cloud were forced into a corner and taken out in one fell swoop!
Without missing a beat... Gee, I forgot you were a game streamer.
Today, the enigmatic heroine re-emerges for this special duel. Watch closely as life and death hang in the balance –
Hold on, let's not take it to life and death...
Onlooker A
Yeah!!
Onlooker B
Is Bamboo Cloud holding a new tournament? They even got someone to do live commentary!
Onlooker C
All I'm gonna remember is how insanely popular Bamboo Cloud's anniversary celebration is...

You're in the right place, chat! As you all know, here at Bamboo Cloud we have the Four Nobles: Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum. The masked heroine before you is none other than "Chrysanthemum," or as she's widely known, Jiu Hua. She's also Fuuka Minami's personal bodyguard.
Facing her is a highly skilled sparring partner who has battled through a rigorous selection process and countless challenges to be here!
No, no, no... I'm not anyone's sparring partner, I'm –
A sly smile spreads across Hibiki Himekawa's face – she instantly recognizes me. Dang it, she's definitely doing this on purpose!

An expression of sudden realization sweeps over the crowd when they hear this. They now regard me with a look that says "this person is not to be taken lightly." As the brave warrior "challenging Chrysanthemum," I've clearly become the protagonist of today's duel.
Well, this is an unexpected development. But since it's {var:player_nickname}, it's likely the will of fate at work again.
As expected of my master!
The mood has reached a boiling point, leaving me no choice but to accept the long spear being handed to me by Jiu Hua and make my way to the clearing in the center of the crowd...
The match officially begins.
Jiu Hua leaps lithely, each step appearing exceedingly nonchalant and only making me less certain of her intentions.
Master! Try to break through her defenses! Look for an opening!
Hearing Ransei's advice, I grit my teeth and launch my attack! I know just where her weak point is...
Strike Jiu Hua's left arm
Strike Jiu Hua's right arm
Strike Jiu Hua's left shoulder
Strike Jiu Hua's right shoulder
I quickly thrust the spear at Jiu Hua, its tip slicing through the air.
But then, in a sudden flash, Jiu Hua darts aside as gracefully as a falling leaf. The tip of my spear narrowly misses her clothing and plunges into the wooden table behind her.
...Uh oh, I used too much force and now it's stuck!
Jiu Hua
Strategies can be deceptive, haha.

And that, folks, is one of Jiu Hua's secret techniques – "Elusiveness." She lures her opponent with unpredictable moves, then seizes her victory. It may look easy, but it's actually a subtle and sophisticated skill!
With a flick of her wrist, Jiu Hua easily frees the spear and tosses it back to me with a beaming smile.
One star for power, zero for precision. Again!
Before I can catch my breath, she's already begun her second attack.
Prove to me... that you're qualified to stand here.
Her flash of silver chills the air around us. I fumble for my spear to block it, feeling utterly helpless.
...Hey, I never said I was qualified in the first place! You guys just didn't listen to me!
Before I can fully comprehend what's happening, my legs instinctively retreat backward. I try to evade Jiu Hua's attack, but she's just too fast, barely giving me even a moment to breathe.
You don't need divination to see that this isn't going to end well.
Argh... I feel a little bad for {var:player_nickname}.
Haha! Just what you'd expect from Jiu Hua's second secret technique, "Flash and Dash"! She vanishes like smoke in the wind, but strikes with the force of a thunderbolt!
Hibiki, your commentary is evolving faster than Jiu Hua moves her spear... Who are you secretly learning from?
Huh? If your mind is still wandering, then it looks like I need to take it up a notch!
A violent tremor reverberates from my hand as Jiu Hua sends my spear flying.
Seeing how bad things are looking for me, the enthusiastic crowd can't sit back any longer.
{var:player_nickname}, you need a weapon. I'll sell you my umbrella for only 50,000 Coppers.
It's a clear autumn day, why do you have an umbrella on you?!
The weather forecast predicted rain.
Master! I went and found the perfect weapon for you! If you use this mop properly, nothing will stop you from unleashing "Secret Technique: Nine-Dragon Heavenly Brush"!
"Secret Technique: Nine-Dragon Heavenly Brush"... What on earth is that?!
All you need to do is embrace the essence of the universe, use your two hands to hold up the heavens, balance your body's three vital energy circulators, and then...
In human language, please!
Master! Master! I found something good in the kitchen, nyaa! You won't be able to win on an empty stomach, take this, nyaa!
I wish this were an eating competition... I'd have you compete instead.
Hey! Since you're Kazuha's precious only student... dang it... I'll let you borrow my sword!
A Nishiba-ryu training uniform? You're Hokuraku's disciple, aren't you? What are you doing here instead of the dojo?!
Nishiba-ryu Disciple
D-Dang it! Not only did you steal the esteemed first disciple's seat, but now you want to deprive us of our right to go out to eat?!
...That's not what I meant.
Never mind, this duel is the most important thing right now. I need to pick a new weapon!
I choose you –
Kaavi's exorbitantly-priced umbrella
Ransei's "Secret Technique: Nine-Dragon Heavenly Brush" mop
Ichihime's fruit basket (A weapon? Really?)
The Nishiba-ryu disciple's sword
Payment accepted. May this umbrella bring you luck.
As a text alert signals the deduction of funds from my bank card, Kaavi tosses the umbrella to me. To my surprise, it opens up on its own mid-air... Its quality looks questionable.
Is this umbrella... really worth that much money?
In full view of the crowd, the black umbrella spins and floats in the air... until a great gust of wind carries it off.
Kaavi, I'd like my refund now.
Oof, bad luck. Seems that, once set in motion, fate's course can't be altered – not even by my lucky umbrella.
Well... it seems the winner has already been decided then.
No! I can still choose another weapon –
This is no ordinary mop! It holds the dual power of combat and cleanliness! Use it to clean up the battlefield, Master!
Okay, let's do this!
I'll offer this mop to you, Master –
Ransei, look out!

Just as Ransei jogs over to me, a cat suddenly darts into her path. To avoid it, she uses the mop like a pole vault, launching herself into the air, where she completes two and a half rotations before landing perfectly back on the ground.
Nice!
I had no idea there'd be such an amazing pre-show! That's Bamboo Cloud for ya!
The crowd bursts into huge applause for Ransei's performance. Ransei trots over to me and wipes the sweat from her flushed face.
Here, Master.
Relax.
I pat Ransei on the shoulder. Amid the crowd's cheers, my focus is actually on the mop – it's wet.
Now that you have your weapon, let us begin. Take this!

The instant Jiu Hua readies her attack, I quickly sidestep, change direction, and angle the mop slightly before making a beeline for her. She agilely leaps out of the way, the corners of her mouth curved into a smirk.
Is that it?
Heh! No, THIS is!
The mop barely grazes the edge of Jiu Hua's shoes, but the momentum causes the fabric at the end to fan out, flinging "dirt weapons" in all directions...
Wails fill the place. Jiu Hua doesn't escape unscathed either.
It has the texture of fabric, the weight of wood, and it sprays water... Shoot, I can't determine this new weapon's distance, speed, or power!
We'll be pausing the live stream for just a moment, guys... I need to... clean... my face!
You're still streaming?!
You may have just flung mud in my face, but since my stream is blowing up to the point that it's starting to lag, I'll let you off the hook. Hehe.
You got this, {var:player_nickname}. Your victory, my skyrocketing views and subs... This is a big win-win for us.
Just when I'm seriously wondering whether I'll be canceled for "flinging mud at a pretty girl" during her live stream, I hear a familiar voice.
I take the fruit basket from Ichihime. It's huge, just looking at it makes me feel safe. However –
Since you seem to have your weapon, let us begin. Take this!
Wait a minute, this isn't a weapon!
But Jiu Hua is already making a lunge for me. In a panic, I start pelting her with apples, pears, and oranges.
Unable to dodge in time, Jiu Hua stumbles as she's struck by an apple. But she then takes a step back and chops through the rest of the fruit.
She's so fast... but this seems to work!

I decide to suppress the powerful Jiu Hua with a high-speed bombardment of fruit. Apples, pineapples, bananas... As she swings wildly through this deluge of fruity projectiles, she finally starts to show signs of fatigue.
You... You're not playing by the rules!
Chat, if you're thinking this fight is too fast for your eyes to follow, then I'll paint you a word picture.
Hm... It's less about speed and more about how wily {var:player_nickname}'s moves are. They're almost impossible to predict.
Hehe, and THAT'S the true genius of our top-tier sparring partner – no strategy is the best strategy.
Quit making up stuff about me, and cut the live stream! This is NOT how I want to be known by everyone in One Han City, dang it!

But I don't have the energy to care about how Hibiki's live stream will drag my name through the mud, because... I'm about to run out of fruit! With each precise jab, the blindfolded Jiu Hua slices cleanly through everything I throw at her.
Munch, munch... Yum, nyaa! Thanks for the sliced fruit, Jiu Hua!
Just as I'm seriously starting to worry about having to throw the basket as well, I hear a familiar voice.
Aren't there any normal people in One Han City?! A sword is obviously the most logical choice! Thank you, fellow disciple I've never met before!
I take the Nishiba-ryu disciple's sword from her under her mixed gaze. I then turn to face Jiu Hua and walk over to her.
The instant Jiu Hua readies her attack, I quickly sidestep, change direction, and angle the blade slightly before making a beeline for her.
Jiu Hua's expression changes faintly, but she still leaps out of the way. The tip of my blade just trims a few of her stray hairs.
From your conversation just now, I gather that you're with Kazuha Saionji? Heh, not bad.
Let's see how you fare this time then.
Jiu Hua's body surges with intensity. She isn't just playing around like before – this time, she's serious.
Wait a minute, I thought this was just a friendly sparring match?!
Humph. If your master can stand on equal footing with Ms. Fuuka, then let's see just how strong her star disciple really is!
Crap, looks like I've gotten myself pulled into a real fight.
Jiu Hua's attacks come with increasing speed. She's moving too fast for me to even think about striking back – I'm stuck on defense now.
But... after blocking just a few times, I realize that the blade I borrowed... is bent! I catch the Nishiba-ryu disciple in the corner of my eye – the color has drained from her face.
Just when I'm seriously considering calling a timeout to save this sword, I hear a familiar voice.
Ume
That's enough, Jiu Hua.
Ume emerges from the crowd and stands beside Jiu Hua and me.
Ume? Why are you here?
The moment Jiu Hua hears Ume's voice, she softens up and stops her attack.
I came to inform you that your new sparring partner is stuck in traffic and hasn't arrived yet.
Wh-Who is this then...?!
This is {var:player_nickname}, the person in charge of the anniversary celebration.
Um... hello!
...Huh?! I-I'm so sorry, just look at the mess I've made, haha...

You were surprisingly skilled and reacted in such extraordinary ways that I thought you were my new sparring partner. I even thought... well... that you were really something. I've never had a sparring match quite like this...
Anyway, I'm very sorry.
It's fine, really. You could say we were just getting to know each other.
I may have been forced into a duel, but it felt pretty good to get some exercise. Plus, no one got hurt.
Since everyone's okay, why don't we continue our discussion over a meal?
With that, Ume turns to the crowd and raises her voice slightly.

Alright everyone, I believe it's time to wrap things up. To thank you for your interest in Bamboo Cloud's anniversary celebration, we're offering a 20% discount at all of our restaurants today. We hope you'll come and enjoy!
Yeah!!
So generous!
You guys will cheer for anything, huh...

Hearing that the show's over but there's a discount at the restaurants, the crowd disperses at once. Even Hibiki, who was deeply invested in the fight only moments ago, gives me a wave before joining the crowd with a mischievous grin on her face.
Just when Ichihime and I are about to follow Ume to the restaurant, I feel a tug on the back of my clothing.
Huh?
U-Ume, there's something I want to talk about with {var:player_nickname}. Could you bring the priestess to the restaurant first? We'll join you shortly.
Ume looks at us both, then nods.
Okay, sure.
Once Ume and Ichihime are out of earshot, Jiu Hua suddenly grabs my hand and hurriedly pulls me over to the kitchen.
I know I was at fault earlier, but you're a kind person who's willing to help those in need...
What happened?
Just then, a series of thumps suddenly echoes from behind the kitchen door. With a loud "bang," something breaks through it...
Shoot, they're gonna make a run for it!
What's gonna make a run for it?

I get my answer before Jiu Hua can respond – a flock of chickens, geese, and pigeons swarms out, filling the air with feathers, clucks, and coos. For some reason, some of the pigeons are even carrying pens and paper in their beaks. It's utter chaos for a while...
Catch.
Jiu Hua throws me a line of thin rope and leads the charge into the swarm.
We have to catch them? Well... I'm no stranger to that.
After a long, hard slog, we finally managed to tie up all the chickens, ducks, and pigeons again. Covered head to toe in feathers, Jiu Hua and I slump to the ground...
"Grumble..." A loud whine comes from one of our stomachs. Jiu Hua and I exchange glances and then burst into laughter.
Looks like we're going to miss out on Ume's feast. How about I treat you to a meal instead? Think of it as an apology for the earlier duel.
To make amends, Jiu Hua takes me to eat at a Bamboo Cloud's restaurant. Once we've had our fill, I finally pluck up the courage to ask her something.
You're Ms. Fuuka's personal bodyguard, right? What were you doing butchering a pigeon in the kitchen this morning?
Those pigeons were for the staff meal. The chef brought them out for me to practice my spear-fighting. Once I finished, I'd give them back to him to cook.
That's what I call a win-win! Pretty clever, if I do say so myself.
A clever person would use a pigeon as her sparring partner?
Her smile suddenly vanishes, and for a moment, the air feels tense.
No one wants to be my sparring partner. The last few all quit on their first day, and the chickens, ducks, and pigeons were all I had left.
I look up at Jiu Hua. The hair hanging over her face casts a shadow over her eyes. She's pretending to be fine, but my heart pangs when I detect a hint of sadness.
Sorry...
That's right – I'm too strong, so no one can keep up with me.
Huh?! Who asked that?!
Hee-hee. But then you came along and solved all my problems.
I never agreed to be your sparring partner! I'm just a supervisor, that's it!
I take an indignant bite of a chicken foot. She watches me with a sly smile, then suddenly turns serious and says:
Hey! I just poured my heart out to you, so you can't tell Ume about the birds escaping. This will be our little secret! Come on, pinky promise me!

Without saying another word, Jiu Hua yanks at my greasy hand, which is still holding the chicken foot. The moment our pinkies – and the chicken foot – interlock, Jiu Hua smiles, her eyes crinkling with delight.
Also... If you won't be my sparring partner, then you'll be my opponent! We'll compete and help each other improve. Relax, you're a genius at martial arts. I'll be coming to you often from now on.
Ahh! Please, I'm too young to die...
Jiu Hua takes off her eye mask and looks at me, then glances around. Her face instantly turns red, and she quickly drops her spear and starts bowing to me, apologizing over and over.
